name: Brothers in Arms: Road to Hill 30
description: Brothers in Arms: Road to Hill 30 is a singleplayer and multiplayer first-person tactical shooter game and the first in the Brothers in Arms series.

audio_settings.title: Enable EAX reverb
audio_settings.reason: Brothers in Arms ships with EAX and 3D sound off and loads its bundled DefOpenAL32.dll instead of the OpenAL32.dll this script installs.

optional_settings.title: Raise anisotropic filtering, grass and decal detail
optional_settings.reason: Out of the box the game uses lower detail settings. This raises anisotropic filtering to 16, grass detail and decoration draw distance to 2, and bullet decals to 256.
